issues.description: The text 'VERD' in the filter options is partially obscured by the 'ALL' filter, making it difficult to read. It appears to be 'VERDANT' or similar, but is clipped.  [and 2 more like it]
The text 'DAWN' in the filter options is partially obscured by the 'HOL' filter, making it difficult to read.
The text 'Owned 13 / 146' and 'Runes: 0' in the top right corner have very low contrast against the dark background, making them hard to read.
The text 'x1' on the 'CINDER RUNNER' card is partially obscured by the number '2' icon, making it hard to read.  [and 2 more like it]
The scrollbar on the right side of the screen is very thin and difficult to see, potentially impacting usability.
